name: The Corsican Pine of the Orto Botanico

location.address: Orto Botanico di Lucca, Via del Giardino Botanico, Lucca

access: Paid entry, Orto Botanico di Lucca
transport: Inside the city walls, Centro Storico; walking distance from Piazza Napoleone
verify_notes: A Corsican pine, 282cm girth and 30.5m tall, planted in 1822 in the same season as the botanical garden's already-published Cedar of Lebanon, making it tie for the oldest tree in the garden. Register-confirmed with a second, independent source (LuccaInDiretta's 2024 survey of the comune's 36 monumental trees).

name: The Magnolia of Via dell'Orto Botanico
transport: Inside the city walls, Centro Storico; walking distance from Piazza Napoleone, just outside the botanical garden
verify_notes: A Southern magnolia, 323cm girth and 24m tall, standing on the street just outside the Orto Botanico, squarely on the walk past the garden's other published trees. No source names or dates this individual tree beyond the national register, so age is not documented; single-sourced, flagged accordingly.

name: The Plane of Via del Fosso

location.neighbourhood: Centro Storico, Via del Fosso canal street

transport: Inside the city walls, Centro Storico; on the canal street between the Orto Botanico and Villa Bottini
verify_notes: A London plane, 360cm girth and 30m tall, on Via del Fosso, the canal street connecting the botanical garden and Villa Bottini. No source names or dates this individual beyond the national register; single-sourced, flagged accordingly.

name: The False Camphor of Via Barsanti e Matteucci

location.neighbourhood: San Marco, outside the city walls

transport: San Marco district, north of the walls; roughly 900m walk from the Orto Botanico cluster
verify_notes: A false camphor tree, 384cm girth and 24m tall, in the San Marco district north of the city walls, about 900m from the botanical garden cluster. A second, younger false camphor (planted 1888) already grows inside the botanical garden. Single-sourced to the national register, flagged accordingly.
